title: RevivalSMP
description: We are a Minecraft Server and We have custom plugins that help boost your experience and you don't have to install them yourself! Join at RevivalSMP.net
body: We are a survival Server inspired by DonutSMP and Lifesteal. We have custom mods that help boost your experience and you don't have to install them yourself! We also have a  comprehensive duels system! Join at RevivalSMP.net
